title: Precision Push Pull
description: Precise push-pull with classic, diamond push-ups and chair dips, then inverted rows and prone raises

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Scapular push-ups
exercises.instructions: In a plank, squeeze and spread the shoulder blades without bending the elbows

exercises.name: Plank to downward dog
exercises.instructions: Alternate between high plank and downward dog

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, body braced, lower chest to the floor

exercises.name: Diamond push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands close together under the chest, elbows along the body

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on the edge, elbows pointing back, lower to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V, lower your head between your hands

exercises.name: Inverted row (table)
exercises.instructions: Under a table, pull your chest toward the edge

exercises.name: Prone T raises
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms in a T, squeeze the shoulder blades

exercises.name: Face pulls on the floor
exercises.instructions: Face down, elbows at 90 degrees, pull backward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind your head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring your foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
